items.stem: A team only needs to move data between stores with no transformation. Which Fabric option does Microsoft suggest as the simplest?

options.rationale: Correct: a copy job gives a simplified data-movement experience when no transformation is needed.

options.text: A full Dataflow Gen2 with many transforms
options.rationale: A dataflow is for transformation; it is heavier than needed for pure movement.
A semantic model is a reporting layer, not a data-movement tool.
A KQL queryset queries real-time data; it does not move data between stores.

items.explanation: Correct: a copy job gives a simplified data-movement experience when no transformation is needed.

items.stem: In Dataflow Gen2, how can a maker confirm that fast copy was actually used for a refresh?

options.text: Check the Engine type in the refresh history
options.rationale: Correct: the refresh history shows the engine type (for example CopyActivity) indicating fast copy ran.
Column count does not indicate which engine ran the refresh.

options.text: Delete the dataflow and recreate it
options.rationale: Deleting the dataflow does not confirm whether fast copy ran.
Pausing capacity stops compute and tells you nothing about the engine used.

items.explanation: Correct: the refresh history shows the engine type (for example CopyActivity) indicating fast copy ran.

items.stem: Which TWO are true about pipelines and dataflows in Fabric Data Factory? (Select TWO)

options.text: Pipelines can run activities on a schedule and orchestrate other items
options.rationale: Correct: pipelines group and schedule activities, including triggering dataflows.

options.text: Dataflow Gen2 uses Power Query to transform data
options.rationale: Correct: Dataflow Gen2 is built on the Power Query experience.

options.text: The Copy activity can only read from OneLake
options.rationale: The Copy activity connects to many cloud and external sources, not only OneLake.

options.text: A ForEach loop forces activities to run one at a time
options.rationale: ForEach can run iterations in parallel to increase throughput.

items.explanation: Correct: pipelines group and schedule activities, including triggering dataflows.
